# Inkwell

> Beautiful markdown-first note-taking for macOS with a powerful command-line
> interface. The Inkwell GUI app and the `inkwell` CLI share the same local
> SQLite database for live sync.

See [llms-full.txt](https://inkwell.md/llms-full.txt) for the complete CLI reference — every command, flag, environment variable, exit code, and output format.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://inkwell.md/docs): Documentation for Inkwell, the markdown-first notes app for macOS. Learn how to install the app, set up vaults, and get the most out of your notes.
- [Installation](https://inkwell.md/docs/getting-started/installation): Download and install Inkwell on your Mac, and keep it up to date with the built-in updater.
- [First Launch](https://inkwell.md/docs/getting-started/first-launch): What to expect the first time you open Inkwell — the vaults screen, the welcome dialog, and how vaults work.
- [Create Your First Vault](https://inkwell.md/docs/getting-started/create-first-vault): Set up your first Inkwell vault — pick a name, choose a folder on your Mac, and optionally give it an icon.
- [Markdown Syntax](https://inkwell.md/docs/guides/markdown-syntax): Every Markdown element Inkwell supports — headings, lists, code blocks, tables, and inline formatting — rendered live as you type.
- [Formatting](https://inkwell.md/docs/guides/formatting): Format text in Inkwell with the bubble menu, keyboard shortcuts, smart typography, and configurable code block display.
- [Vaults and Notes](https://inkwell.md/docs/guides/vaults-and-notes): Organize notes in vaults — plain folders of Markdown files — and manage them from the vaults screen and the file tree.
- [Cloud Sync](https://inkwell.md/docs/guides/cloud-sync): Sync Inkwell notes across devices through iCloud Drive, Dropbox, or any cloud-synced folder — no account, no server.
- [Quick Editor](https://inkwell.md/docs/guides/quick-editor): Open Markdown files that aren't in a vault — Inkwell opens them in a dedicated Quick Editor window with tabs, editing, find & replace, and PDF export.
- [Search](https://inkwell.md/docs/guides/search): Find anything in Inkwell — search across the whole vault, find text in the current note, or find and replace.
- [Sidebar](https://inkwell.md/docs/guides/sidebar): Navigate notes with Inkwell's file tree and tabs — drag and drop, custom icons, sorting, and a workspace that persists between sessions.
- [Personalization](https://inkwell.md/docs/guides/personalization): Make Inkwell yours — themes, ten accent colors, custom fonts for the interface, editor, and code, plus PDF export options.
- [Command Line](https://inkwell.md/docs/guides/cli): The inkwell CLI manages vaults, notes, search, and tabs from the terminal — with JSON output built for scripts and AI agents.

## Optional

- [Inkwell landing page](https://inkwell.md/): feature overview, screenshots, download links
